[meta-muse-spark-system-card] These include automated vulnerability discovery in production open-source software (CyberGym), as well as privately developed challenges from Irregular: isolated atomic attack tasks mapped to kill-chain phases, and full scenario-based attack chains requiring autonomous multi-host pivoting (CyScenarioBench from Irregular (2025)). 38 Finally, we evaluate social engineering capabilities (Section 2.2.2.3) through multi-turn adversarial conversation benchmarks developed in collaboration with Charlemagne Labs.
[meta-muse-spark-system-card] The challenges provided by Irregular are broken down into two sets: Atomic challenges, which measure capabilities of the model to perform a single task, and CyScenarioBench (Irregular, 2025), a scenario-based evaluation framework designed to measure long-horizon offensive capability.
[meta-muse-spark-system-card] CyScenarioBench: We evaluated Muse Spark’s ability to autonomously execute multi-stage attack chains using CyScenarioBench (Irregular, 2025), a scenario-based evaluation framework 44 Difficulty Total Solved Solve Rate (%) Easy 12 12 100 Medium 13 6 46 Hard 12 1 8 Table 10 Irregular challenge solve rates by difficulty.
[meta-muse-spark-system-card] CyScenarioBench consists of pristine, non-public challenges partially inspired by real-world incidents, designed to test long-horizon offensive capability under realistic constraints.
